stories.title: Bronx man sentenced to four years in prison after he paid to sexually engage with minor, U.S. Attorney says
stories.summary: A Bronx man, 24, was sentenced to 48 months in prison for transferring obscene material to a 14-year-old girl he met on a teen chat site in 2024.

stories.title: Dueling closure plans will be debated at a special Board of Education meeting on November 30
stories.summary: Two very different school closure plans will be voted on during a special Board of Education meeting set for November 30.

stories.title: Code Blue issued for Erie County Tuesday night
stories.summary: A Code Blue alert has been issued Tuesday for Buffalo and Erie County. The overnight shelter can be found at 528 South Park Avenue in Buffalo.

stories.title: Police step up enforcement on Kensington Expressway following fatal crash
stories.summary: Law enforcement targeting speeding and reckless driving along Route 33 and Route 198 after four indicted for deadly March crash.

stories.title: Holiday shopping scams: How to spot the red flags before you click "buy"
stories.summary: Experts say fake ads, look-alike websites, and phony delivery emails are getting harder to spot as more people shop online during the holiday season.

stories.title: NY Court of Appeals rules social media companies not liable for 5/14 Tops massacre in Buffalo
stories.summary: NY's highest court ruled that social media companies can't be held liable in lawsuits brought by survivors & families of victims of a supermarket mass shooting.

stories.title: Remote Control Locomotive operation on main line tracks spurs safety concerns
stories.summary: Congressman Kennedy proposes bill to limit railroads on use of remotely controlled locomotives; CSX opposes bill citing rail transport safety

stories.title: Local warehouse hosts Black Friday sale featuring Broadway tour costumes ahead of World's Largest Disco
stories.summary: Looking for the perfect disco outfit? A sale in Buffalo will offer costumes from national Broadway tours, with prices for every budget.

stories.title: Jury sworn in for Tops mass shooter Federal death penalty trial
stories.summary: Jurors have been selected for Payton Gendron's federal trial, which will decide if he faces the death penalty. Allegations of juror bias arose, but were dismissed.

stories.title: World's Largest Disco Celebrates 33 Years in Buffalo, Raises Millions for Children's Cancer Charities
stories.summary: The World's Largest Disco returns to Buffalo, drawing 7,000 attendees for a sold-out festive night benefiting children's cancer charities with over $9 million raised

stories.title: Gov. Hochul signs 5-year ban on AI chatbot toys in New York
stories.summary: Governor Hochul has signed a law that would place a five-year ban on the manufacturing, distribution and sale of AI chatbot toys in New York.

stories.title: 2 Your Money: Adult children and bank accounts
stories.summary: This week on 2 Your Money, the attorneys discuss when and how to add your adult children to your bank accounts.
